description:
Remove the batch-create unit tests that repeat the keyed graph's cycle tests over an adapter.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/graph/mod.rs` owns dependency cycle rejection, and `crates/jit/src/graph/keyed.rs:145-195` owns keyed cycle detection, including a property-based test (`:344`). Three other tests that mention cycles own different properties and stay: repository validation reporting a stored cycle (`fast_rules/validation_tests.rs:61`), batch-create atomicity (`cli_issue/batch_create_tests.rs:196`) and atomic rejection of a dependency batch (`fast_issue/bulk_operations_tests.rs:221`). `crates/jit/src/commands/batch_create.rs:640` adapts keyed detection, and four tests at `:686-707` repeat the keyed tests over that adapter.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The four adapter tests in `commands/batch_create.rs` no longer exist; at most one test there shows that batch creation rejects a cyclic manifest through the adapter.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each cycle property the removed tests covered has an owning test in `crates/jit/src/graph/`.
title: Batch-create stops re-proving keyed cycle detection
